resource_scope: Whole launched process including runtime/source verification; Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN max RSS. Not model-only, cgroup or SSC305 measurements.
step_observation_timing: step-XXXX finite_loss and finite_grad_norm are measured before that optimizer update; pair-XXXX samples are measured after that update. Same-numbered records must not be forced to have equal losses.
interpretation: Reported NLL decreases, but only one of two training pair items matches after 300 updates. The final KW1 string match completes within the first 105 ms, inside its exact-zero 200 ms prefix; it is not evidence of recognition at actual acoustic positions. KW2 first 105 ms RMS is 5.069523467741744e-05, very low energy rather than exact silence. The saved greedy path supports early low-energy emission/alignment failure, not a conclusion about all CTC probability mass. Energy thresholds are descriptive, not validated VAD. This does not establish that the architecture cannot converge or that class weighting is ineffective; A/B never ran.
